name: Argothian Elves
description: Elves who lived on the forest island of Argoth until the Sylex Blast.

description_citations.text: "Elf". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth turns the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague that eats away the elves.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a virulent plague that ate away the elves there.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth kidnaps the priestess Elyssendril and her healers and extorts the elves.
timeline.quote: When the elves paid, he delivered only sweetened water and 12 dead healers to them.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harbin is helped by an Argothian elf and tells Urza of the island.
timeline.quote: When, millennia later, Harbin stumbled upon Argoth, he was helped by an Argothian elf.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex and destroys Argoth and its elves.
timeline.quote: ultimately they were all destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex
